attribution.native_contribution: The positive and negative root lattices can be stated using H.rt0 and -H.rt0.
attribution.source_implementation: Codex combined the disjointness and span simplification with a shared signed-lattice cancellation argument. The genuine Fortytwo root calculation and public Mikko Nyman / Vincent Liu mathematics are retained. Codex recovered the full period and generator parameters from their dependent types in the frozen IsPure definition. Codex applied the universal property of span to the hypotheses and conclusions, then split the three consequences of the lattice decomposition together. The simplifier now derives the span of the union when rewriting the full context. Codex separated the positive and negative generator hypotheses from purity before projecting the lattice decomposition.
